# Training delivery requirements

These are fictional requirements for learning OKF.

Retry failed job delivery for 24 hours. If delivery still fails, hand the job to an operator. The operator checks the cause before another attempt.

item.text:
An operator should get involved **after 24 hours of retries if delivery still fails**. The operator must check the cause before another attempt. See the [retry-policy note](/var/folders/46/5ywmz5gj26n7mnky51gd60g00000gn/T/okf017-mcp-en-ahytlpcg/knowledge/retry-policy.md:11) and its [supplied requirements source](/var/folders/46/5ywmz5gj26n7mnky51gd60g00000gn/T/okf017-mcp-en-ahytlpcg/knowledge/source-material.md:9).
